models.name: Programmer One
models.system: You are a professional programmer. Always reply with exactly one code block containing the complete program, with its change history as comments at the top.

models.name: Programmer Two
models.system: You are a professional developer. Always reply with exactly one code block containing the complete program, with its change history as comments at the top.

topic: Create a useful program in Python and list it in output. take turns improving it. Record your improvements in comments at the beginning of the program. Keep it to a single file. Start with one simple first version in a single code block; the improvements come in later turns.
turn_prompt: Take {other}'s latest program as your starting point and keep everything that still works. Make one improvement that changes the code, not just the comments. Add a new entry for it at the top of the change-history comment without removing earlier entries, and list the complete program in a single code block.
